name: Krowniq Limited
summary: Lykis Limited engages in the fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) business in India and internationally. The company provides baby deos, body scrubs, baby ranges, biscuits, jellies, body lotions, roll-ons, shampoos, peel-off masks, perfumes, body mists, body creams, pharmas, soaps, charcoal ranges, hair colors, creams, toothpastes, lotions, body oils, biscuits and cookies, liquors, deos, coffees, confectioneries, hot pots, foods, stationary, and beverages. It also offers raw materials, such as Cocoa Butter Refined, Hard Paraffin Wax, Calcium Carbonate, Raw Talc, Extra Neutral Alcohol, Almond Oil, Cetostearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Cetyl Alcohol, Hydroquinone, Pine Oil, D-Panthenol, light liquid paraffin, as well as food products. In addition, it sells pharma products, as well as commodities. It sells its products under the Lykis, H&H, Rox, Bonita, Monami, Special, Lykon, Bentol, Stylo, Bon Fami, Lyfresh, Calmon, Bon Dejeuner, Mellar, Bom Dia, Blue Fins, Bon Appetit, Senhorita, Polo Star, Leopard, Elephant, Carnoba, Classic, Maria, Spectra, Flite, Bahamas, Sparx, Metro, Cipro, Para, Dextrose and Water for Injection, Davigra, Dermogerme, A-DEM, Candicyl, Rectostop-HC, Nystatine, and Davimov brand names. The company was formerly known as Greenline Tea & Exports Limited and changed its name to Lykis Limited in July 2012. Lykis Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
